title: A Randomized Approximation Algorithm for Doubly Free-Boundary Macdonald Processes
summary: We construct an approximate sampler for finite doubly free-boundary Macdonald rail-yard processes with Macdonald, boundary, and edge parameters in $(0,1)$. The construction allows arbitrary finite sequences of additions and removals of horizontal or vertical strips and all four boundary types. It reverses a finite commutation--reflection history from a partition sequence whose entries are equal, with the common partition weighted by both boundaries.
